market.question: Will the highest temperature in Busan be 23°C on May 9?

assessment.reasoning: Forecast for Gimhae Intl Airport (Busan) on May 9 is ~73°F = 22.8°C. Bucket '23°C' likely covers 23.0-23.9°C. Forecast 22.8°C sits just below the bucket; with typical short-range forecast error of ±1-2°C, probability the actual high lands in the 23°C bin is moderate.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Day-of cloud cover and wind shifts can push high up or down by 1-2°C.
